cohort: The study included women diagnosed with either intrinsic or extrinsic adenomyosis (AM) via MRI, who subsequently underwent a hysterectomy and pathological examination.
finding: Intrinsic and extrinsic adenomyosis exhibit distinct clinical profiles, perioperative characteristics, and associated risk factors; specifically, intrinsic AM was associated with lower education, higher gravidity, and more endometrial curettage, while extrinsic AM was associated with earlier menarche, ovarian endometrioma, deep infiltrating endometriosis, more severe dysmenorrhea, and higher perioperative costs.
